description: This file defines the FeatureDefinition interface, which represents a list of unique, fully qualified DefinitionIdentifiers. It includes static methods for creating FeatureDefinitions from identifiers, JSON strings, or JSON arrays, and methods to access the first identifier, size, and stream of identifiers.

classes.name: FeatureDefinition
classes.description: An interface representing a list of unique, fully qualified DefinitionIdentifiers with methods for creation, access, and streaming.

methods.name: fromIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from a primary identifier and optional additional identifiers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from a JSON string representing a JsonArray.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from a JsonArray object.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the first DefinitionIdentifier in the FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of identifiers in the FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the identifiers in the FeatureDefinition.
